reason: The automatic VAT e-invoice with our tax code is the thing OpenRouter can't give me, and my accountant chases me every month for it. At provider price with no 5.5% fee, I'd move part of our traffic over and keep OpenRouter as a fallback.
objection: Adding a middleman adds latency and another point of failure, and I don't know this company yet, so I won't move production traffic until I see it hold up.
would_change_my_mind: If the first VAT invoice is wrong or late, or latency is noticeably worse than OpenRouter, I'd stop.
